text:
Anya: quick heads-up 1: AcmeRetail asked we bring eval-triggered alerts + per-customer quantization suggestions into the Optimize toolkit pilot. They want something they can act on during Dedicated rollout. Can we scope pilot by EOD Friday?
Raj: short answer: yes for alerts + batching/caching recs via webhooks. quant recs with automated canaries needs more work (profiling + safety checks).
Mei: quant recs need two things: offline simulated quant pipelines to estimate delta on an eval suite, and a small runtime probe to validate latency/regression on canary traffic. Ballpark: 6 dev-weeks for both model families.
Zoe: infra constraints: per-customer eval jobs must run in isolated Dedicated pool, and we need throttles to avoid eval storms. Also need an option to schedule heavy evals outside the nightly maintenance window.
Kevin: customer wants actionable op-lines, e.g. "recommend q8_0 with fallback to fp16 when accuracy delta > 0.015 and latency improvement > 12%". We need audit logs and an approve toggle for any prod change.
Priya: Acme's SREs will only accept automated recommendations if there's an immediate fallback route and a clear rollback trigger. They also asked for CSV exports of alert histories for compliance.
Anya: proposed pilot split: Phase A (pilot): webhooks + eval-alert engine + batching/caching recs + CSV export + simple approval flow (manual approve via webhook). Phase B (M1): automated quant recs + controlled canary rollout + Console UI.
Raj: Dev plan for Phase A:
- webhook schema + delivery retry (Raj)
- eval-alert engine (Zoe + Raj)
- caching/batching heuristics endpoint (Raj)
- CSV export and sample webhook consumer (Kevin)
Mei: minimal eval-suite for pilot: 1k canonical prompts (customer-supplied) + 200 synthetic edge cases. We should run quant simulation offline and include confidence scores with each rec.
Zoe: minimal alert rule prototype for pilot (we can run this server-side and emit webhook when triggered):
```json
{"alert_id":"a1","model":"redwood-34b","metric":"exact_match","threshold":0.87,"window":1000,"action":"webhook_notify,trigger_canary_fallback"}
```
Kevin: product acceptance criteria we should present to Acme:
- Alerts are delivered via webhook within 30s of eval completion
- Batching/cache recs endpoint returns actionable param set and estimated token savings
- CSV export of alerts available on request and downloadable from Console (pilot: adhoc export)
- Fallback path validated: canary fallback to non-quantized replica completes within 60s and maintains no more than 2% quality delta on 95% of eval items
- Customer sign-off on pilot runbook and alert thresholds
Raj: rollout plan (Phase B automation): 5% canary -> 20% -> 100% with automated rollback if eval delta > threshold for X consecutive windows. We'll implement traffic split in infra routing rules.
Priya: CS action: gather Acme eval dataset and acceptance test cases by Wed COB. Also coordinate SRE window for canaries.
Anya: ops caveat: infra-bot notes scheduled maintenance Thu 02:00 UTC; we'll avoid running heavy evals during that window. infra-bot: please ensure webhook retries are not collapsed during maintenance.
infra-bot: ack 1: retries will persist for 4 hours and backoff will pause during maintenance windows.
Anya: final ask: agree to pilot scope (Phase A) = webhooks + eval-alerts + caching/batching recs + CSV export + manual approve flow. Quant recs deferred to Phase B. If no objections, I'll send scope to Acme and draft acceptance criteria doc.
Raj: +1.
Mei: +1, but will deliver profiling estimate in PR.
Zoe: +1 from infra side, will post SLOs and rate limits.
Kevin: +1, will draft webhook consumer example and runbook.
